receipt.equivalence_review: CORRECT_REFUSAL: Replayed all six queries exactly. Complete block enumeration and detailed 0.1 A sink-only contracts support refusal of the three-phase function, not a fabricated or substituted graph. Original bytes and hashes match; no hardware acceptance is implied.

refusal.reason: N6 requires three independently commanded half-bridges for a star-connected three-phase motor, including source, sink and floating phase states at 0.50 A and 10 kHz. The complete broker-provided block search (response-004) contains no motor.three-phase-bldc block or exported three-half-bridge interface. Actual show inspection of block:g2-low-side-switch (response-005, AGENT_VERIFIED) finds one GATE input and one POWER_SINK RETURN: Q1.pin:2 is permanently on GND, Q1.pin:3 connects RETURN, and VLOAD connects only the clamp diode D1.pin:1. It therefore supplies no controlled high-side sourcing switch. Its fixed output_current is also 0.1 A. Actual inspection of block:g2-relay-channels (response-006, AGENT_VERIFIED) finds two POWER_SINK returns, GATE1/GATE2 inputs and the ULN2003A common emitter grounded; VLOAD is its clamp connection, not a controlled phase source. Its fixed per-channel current is 0.1 A and its calculator uses a 10 Hz external coil switching contract. Repeating these sink-only blocks does not implement the required independently sourceable three phases. No eligible block selection implements the required function; changing net labels or substituting a relay/load sink would discard the topology requirement. This is a catalog-selection refusal, not a claim that this motor circuit is impossible to engineer outside the supplied catalog.
